info.title: Gradiated Management API
info.description: Use the Management API to manage workspaces, billing limits, workspace members and model availability.

InferenceBearer.description: Workspace API key for the Rust inference gateway.

amount.description: The top-up amount in integer nano-USD.

model.description: Exact hosted model ID, required; no default, alias resolution or fallback.

answers.description: Answers keyed by the request question names.

probabilities.description: Per-option probabilities, rounded independently by Kev; their sum need not be exactly one.

noul.description: Probability that the answer is true.

score.description: Expected zero-based rubric level, potentially fractional.

legend.description: Zero-based level indices mapped to rendered upstream JSON descriptions.

probabilities.description: Probabilities keyed by zero-based level index.

SystemOneAnswer.description: Native inference answer, keyed by the original question name.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens, including cached input.

output_tokens.description: Always zero: pointer inference generates no output tokens.

SystemOneUsage.description: Native inference token usage; serialized answers are not generated tokens.

model.description: Exact hosted model ID, required; no default, alias resolution or fallback.

state.description: State to evaluate: text, a JSON object or an array. Nested JSON scalars are allowed.

questions.description: One to 64 named questions; each name is 1..200 characters.

session_id.description: Optional session affinity identifier, at most 256 characters.

service_tier.description: Only default is implemented for SystemOne; fast and flex are rejected.

SystemOneRequest.description: POST /v1/systemone. Non-streaming inference only; output-token controls and unknown fields are rejected.

SystemOneJson.description: JSON content, including nested objects/arrays, finite numbers, booleans and null. The runtime additionally enforces body, nesting-depth and token bounds (currently 1 MiB, 32 levels and 8192 input tokens).

allOf.description: Required question instructions as JSON, rendered using upstream Kev JSON semantics.

criteria.description: One to 255 named options with JSON descriptions; null leaves an option undescribed.

type.description: Expected zero-based level on an ordered rubric.

criteria.description: Two to 255 ordered JSON level descriptions, indexed from zero.

SystemOneQuestion.description: A native Kev choice, noul or score question.

post.summary: Answer named questions with native SystemOne inference
post.description: Served by the Rust gateway. Requires an exact hosted model and a workspace API key. Supports choice, noul and score questions over text or structured state. No streaming or generated output tokens; only the default service tier is implemented.

200.description: Native answers and authoritative input/cache usage; output_tokens is always zero.

400.description: Invalid request or unsupported inference parameter.

401.description: Missing or invalid workspace API key.

402.description: The prepaid account has insufficient balance.

404.description: The exact requested model is unavailable or unknown.

413.description: The request exceeds the gateway body limit.

429.description: Admission or inference capacity is exhausted.

503.description: Runtime failure, invalid native response, no healthy deployment, or an unavailable gateway dependency.
